gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 31 Dec 2021 were GBP 192.604m. During 2022 the syndicate recorded a net favourable prior year development of GBP 26.741m (a release 13.9% of opening gross claims). Management attribute the prior year improvement primarily to favourable claims development together with a Loss Portfolio Transfer (LPT) / reinsurance arrangement with Enstar (transferring 2018 & prior year liabilities and generating material reinsurance recoveries of c.GBP 43.4m) which mitigated inflationary pressure on older reserves. A small COVID-19 provision remains (GBP 4.0m).

The 2020 & prior year of account is closing by Reinsurance to close (RITC) after 36 months with a cumulative GAAP profit of GBP 24,455,000 (2019 & prior years of account - GBP 14,362,000) and a distributable profit of GBP 24,484,000 (2019 & prior years of account - GBP 13,618,000).
Included within the above are GBP 43,400,000 of reinsurance recoveries in respect of the 2018 & prior legacy transaction (2021: nil)
